values.subject: Additional onboarding health materials and background-check authorization
values.body_text: By June 18, please submit the complete physical-examination report, three years of clinic records, long-term medication information, and physician contact details to our background-screening vendor, Anheng Consulting. The current authorization does not distinguish data categories, remains continuously valid, and names our company and partner organizations as recipients. Onboarding approval is paused until submission.
